The domestic austerity set (subsidy rollback, electricity rationing, 'we have no money') is the strongest blockade-bite evidence printed so far and is the mechanism by which 'new paths' could become concessions - or protests (2019 precedent cited). The IRGC/army split on the Kuwait event (army denies; Al Jazeera says the IRGC claimed radar strikes - undated) is a command-coherence question the orchestrator may want to track.

SOMO's 20-30 mb deferral is the first printed exporter-side volume response to the strike cluster (Iraq exports ~all via Hormuz; Oct output 4.6 mb/d) - whichever the cause, it removes prompt MEG cargoes in the week OPEC+ debates Iraq's capacity. 223-26 sits on the Khasab outbound lane where Tehran claimed two mined tankers; the authority version is one hull, a projectile, crew accounted for (one serious injury per the manager) - the orchestrator should keep 'mine claims confirmed' at 0 and 'projectile hits' at 4. The ADNOC L&S death is the first fatality and a crewing/insurance input (no quote printed).

items.note: T4 / HARD-EVENT screen: Jazan MEETS the 'confirmed-damage Gulf facility strike' wording on the evidence - a Saudi Energy Ministry statement (via SPA) confirming a projectile hit, a fire, a fatality and 'some operations temporarily halted' at a Saudi Aramco refinery - with two caveats for the orchestrator: (i) Jazan is on the Red Sea coast (Houthi-attributed), not a Gulf/Hormuz-side facility, and (ii) no output, restart or export figure is printed (400 kb/d design capacity; the Jazan complex is a domestic/export products refinery, not a crude terminal). Ras Tanura (Gulf side, Wed) is still unconfirmed by Riyadh/Aramco. The Kuwait event is the first attack in the war to kill European civilians and the first Iranian-attributed strike Tehran has disowned; the Israeli line (Defrin 'without the Americans', cabinet convened) plus the US adviser message pulling the other way puts the Israel-first branch back in play on the same day. Market: Brent +2.07% Thu settle, +0.95% to 97.49 Fri 07:30Z; the single-day move stays under USD 5.
